Docs.summary:
Resolves a using a priority waterfall:
API — calls GetCandidateConfigFlat using the client's configured endpoint and credential pipeline.
Env var — reads OPTIMIZATION_CONFIG as inline JSON and deserializes it. Returns a wrapping the resolved config so callers can inspect HTTP status and headers. When falling back to the env var, the response from the failed API call is preserved when available. Returns null when no source matches.
Docs.returns: The resolved config wrapped in a , or null when no source matched.
